intent: Close the six review threads on PR #1444 without widening the operator's authority: preserve the repository-wide WIP ceiling while enforcing a separate four-lane Mac build scope; move focus authority into prerequisites; bind RSI exact-code completion to digest-sealed Mac and Meghadharma commit/tree observations; include the Mission Control test in Fleet ownership; and require SADHANA tests to execute rather than merely exist. One ancestry review is stale on the current head and requires no code change. This packet grants no runtime, deployment, credential, spend, participant, outreach, or promotion authority.

interface_mismatches: The operator directive is scoped to Mac build admission, while the inherited max_active checker applies repository-wide; scoped_wip_limits and admission_scopes must preserve that authority boundary.
The generic focus receipt is admission authority rather than engineering completion, and its RSI boolean does not mechanically attest either host's commit or tree.
The completion report previously combined prerequisites and completion rows without role labels, making a correct denominator unnecessarily ambiguous to readers.
honest_blockers: Admission scopes constrain declared build authority only; they do not prove a process is running on the named host.

The RSI witness normalizes selected non-secret fields from external runtime receipts; exact commit/tree identity does not prove campaign execution, research quality, executor liveness, or promotion authority.
SADHANA intentionally remains incomplete on this base until its separately governed release package lands and its test criterion executes green.
Fleet, RSI, and Sublimation can satisfy their current criteria while remaining non-shippable because their explicit blocker next-items are still open.
The exposed Anthropic and AGNI/GLM credentials observed during local cockpit recovery require owner-controlled rotation; this governance packet neither stores nor rotates credentials.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this packet and its allowed implementation, evidence, and generated inventory surfaces together. Rollback restores the globally over-broad four-track cap and weaker progress/evidence projections but performs no runtime, remote-host, credential, participant, provider, deployment, or external-state mutation.
